headlines.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
headlines.summary: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.

headlines.title: Azerbaijan intensifies its European engagement at the EPC Summit
headlines.summary: Azerbaijan added additional thrust to its engagement with Europe announcing more energy to the EU, a strategic partnership with the UK, additional agreements with Ukraine, a dozen bilateral meetings with European leaders and a new meeting with Armenia to advance the historic peace process.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: EU deal on Ukraine talks overshadows AI-focused summit in Dublin
headlines.summary: EU leaders have agreed that the E5 format — Germany, France, U.K, Italy and Poland — plus the European Commission and Council will represent the bloc at any future peace negotiations.

headlines.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
headlines.summary: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.

headlines.title: Nvidia has lost nearly $2tn in value. What could it be worth without Jensen Huang?
headlines.summary: Nvidia has lost about $1.8tn (€1.6tn) in market value since its record close on 6 October. After Jensen Huang’s exit, investors are weighing whether the chipmaker can keep growing at the pace that made it the biggest name in AI.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang: Spy row, affairs leave Nvidia without its rockstar CEO
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang, who built Nvidia into the world’s dominant AI chipmaker, is stepping down as CEO over extramarital affairs. DW examines how losing its figurehead will affect the firm and the US-China AI race.

headlines.title: Why Europe failed to find a superhero to take on Putin
headlines.summary: Europe’s seven-part team of Ukraine peace envoys must now agree their strategy for handling Russia.

headlines.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.

headlines.title: Hungary’s MOL seeks EU funding as CEO warns Russian oil phase-out could trigger social unrest
headlines.summary: MOL says it could phase out Russian oil imports by the end of 2027, but chief Bacsa warns that higher energy costs could fuel political instability in Hungary and Slovakia. He is calling for EU funding to expand alternative pipeline routes, as Brussels keeps focus on quitting Russian energy.

headlines.title: Is AIIB s complaint mechanism failing affected communities?
headlines.summary: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank has a grievance redress mechanism for people affected by projects it finances. But those seeking to file a complaint face significant hurdles. Critics say reforms are needed.

headlines.title: Le Pen offers to meet Zelenskyy in Brussels
headlines.summary: The Ukrainian leader wants to persuade the far-right leader to continue supporting Ukraine if she becomes president of France.

headlines.title: Pressure grows on Trump's Commerce Secretary Lutnick in fallout from Nvidia scandal
headlines.summary: Scott Bessent told CNBC that several government agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".

headlines.title: China to encourage investment in Turkish renewable energy with $15bn solar and wind deal
headlines.summary: Türkiye wants to sharply expand solar and wind power by 2040 and is seeking foreign investment to fund the work.

headlines.title: Megaspeed and the battle to go high-end Nvidia chips into China
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang s affair with a suspected Chinese spy has shone a light on Megaspeed, the company she worked for. It is under investigation in the US for smuggling Nvidia chips into China, which it denies.

headlines.title: Cut off from Europe, Russia will have to rewire its Arctic gas trade
headlines.summary: From 2027, Europe will no longer buy Russian LNG from Yamal. Getting the gas to Asia means longer trips, costlier ships and contractual workarounds.

headlines.title: The rise of 'housefishing' - when does using AI go from enhancing to misleading?
headlines.summary: Experts warn that using AI to enhance property images can go too far and mislead prospective buyers.

headlines.title: Mercedes-Benz halts new investment in German plants, considers closures
headlines.summary: The Stuttgart carmaker is temporarily halting all further investment at its German sites. Possible plant closures are looming, increasing pressure on staff, works council and IG Metall. Volkswagen and Audi have also announced major savings programmes.

headlines.title: Microsoft outage renews European calls to detox from US tech
headlines.summary: Lawmakers across Europe call for action to reduce reliance on a handful of foreign tech companies.

headlines.title: Heat pumps: How much heat does your home really need?
headlines.summary: Knowing how much heat your home loses is important before installing a new heating system.

trend_headline: MS 대란과 독일 자동차 위기, 유럽의 자립 압박 가중
summary: 마이크로소프트의 글로벌 서비스 중단 사태가 미국 빅테크 의존도에 대한 유럽의 경계심을 고조시키는 한편, 메르세데스-벤츠의 독일 내 투자 중단 및 구조조정 검토는 유럽 제조업의 심각한 비용 압박을 드러내고 있습니다. 또한 헝가리 MOL이 러시아산 원유 수단 전환을 위한 EU 지원을 촉구하는 등 에너지 안보와 산업 경쟁력 재편 압력이 커지고 있습니다.
key_points: 마이크로소프트의 글로벌 IT 대란으로 유럽 의회 등에서 미국 빅테크 의존도를 낮추기 위한 '디톡스' 자립 목소리 확산
메르세데스-벤츠가 독일 내 공장 신규 투자를 전면 중단하고 구조조정을 검토하며 자동차 섹터 침체 우려 심화
헝가리 MOL, 2027년까지 러시아산 원유 단계적 폐지를 추진하며 대체 파이프라인 확장을 위한 EU 재정 지원 요구
